svg.text: HeartSync DOCK rev H: HeartSync lands in front on magnets + pogo pins (no cradle), pod behind. Every part flat, 1:1
Tray 195 x 124 x 14 · landing strip (0.8 mm recess, no walls) · column 62 x 40 x 146 · iPhone puck 132 up (above the HeartSync) · buds pad · band bay · USB-A + 2 USB-C · print 100 % on A3 landscape
A TRAY TOP 195 x 124 (front corners R8, back R20)
LANDING STRIP 187 x 37, 0.8 mm deep: the HeartSync stands here on its bottom edge, display to the front, back ring to the pod
no walls · 4 magnets 6 x 2 under 1 mm (opposite pole) pull it in · 4 spring pogo pins 2.5 rise 1 mm · dashed = device footprint
C TRAY SIDE, unrolled (14 tall, top edge = deck)
D COLUMN WRAP 169.7 x 146, seam at the back centre
E COLUMN TOP, PHONE PUCK, BAND BAY
D-numbers = dock BOM · black = cut / hole · grey dash = fold · purple = mount / ring / strip · orange dots = part inside
